title: Yellowed Crispy Korean Chicken Bokkeum
description: A high-protein Korean dish featuring crispy chicken, peppercorns, and umami flavors, served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, crushed peppercorns, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and coat with cornstarch, shaking off excess.
Air fry the chicken for 10 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together 1 tablespoon of water and 1 tablespoon of cornstarch to make a slurry.
Add the slurry to the air fryer and stir to coat the chicken evenly.
Air fry for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and slightly caramelized.
Transfer the chicken to a terracotta dish and garnish with chopped scallions.
